context.text: Chantelle Fiddy ('Hitting the Target', first in Touch magazine, posted 25 Oct 2004) lists Poltergeist/Runaway and a Terror Danjah remix among releases on Target's Aim High label.

The Aim High Vol. 2 press release posted by Fiddy (7 Jan 2005) gives Aim High's catalogue: AIM001 'Pick Yourself Up', AIM002 'Poltergeist', AIM003 'Chosen One' feat. Riko, AIM004 'Poltergeist Rmx' by Terror Danjah, AIM005 'STDS' feat. OT Crew.
DJ Target (Darren Joseph) is an East London producer, formerly of Pay As U Go, and a co-founder of Roll Deep with Wiley.
